name: Free Music Finder
author: moshi
description: Find music and import full Spotify/Deezer playlists with Music Hunters and DeezLoad, saved queues and automatic fallback. These are third-party bots; what you download is your responsibility.

settings.label: Last.fm API key
settings.description: Optional: faster, better For you artist picks. Create a free key at https://www.last.fm/api/account/create (any name, callback empty), then paste the 32-character API key, not the secret. Only artist names and the titles of up to 10 songs you like are sent to Last.fm, through your Proxy setting. Noctis keeps this setting as plain text. Leave empty to use the other catalogs.

settings.label: Fill artist and album pages from online catalogs
settings.description: Add online releases to Noctis's existing Albums, Singles & EPs and Appears On sections. Native album pages show owned songs and missing songs with download actions. Metadata uses the same Proxy setting. Browsing never downloads audio.

settings.label: Shortcut
settings.description: Press this anywhere in Noctis to open the Search page (on a Mac, Ctrl means Cmd). Write it like Ctrl+Shift+F or Ctrl+Alt+M; leave it empty to turn it off. If Noctis itself uses the same keys, Noctis wins.

settings.label: Open Search
settings.description: Open the native Search page. Quicker: press the shortcut above anywhere in Noctis. You can also right-click any track → "Find more by this artist…".

settings.label: Telegram account…
settings.description: Open the Telegram window: connect your account, see which account is signed in, or disconnect it to sign in with another one. Downloading a song while you are not signed in opens it too.

settings.label: First bot
settings.description: The other bot is the reserve.

settings.label: Keep played songs
settings.description: Songs you only played, not added to Songs.

settings.label: Download ahead
settings.description: Next songs in the queue you don't have. Off: each downloads when it plays.

settings.label: Preferred audio quality
settings.description: Sets both Music Hunters and DeezLoad to this format before requesting music. MP3 is saved immediately; FLAC checks the backup if the first bot sends MP3. Settings must be confirmed by each bot; unsupported or changed menus are reported.

settings.label: Allow MP3 fallback for FLAC
settings.description: When FLAC is preferred but neither bot can supply it, save the MP3 instead. Off means FLAC only. Does not apply when MP3 is your preferred quality.

settings.label: Download folder
settings.description: Leave empty to save into "Noctis Free Music" inside your first Noctis library folder, so downloads appear in the library right away (needs Watch Folders on). If you set a folder outside the library, add it to your Noctis library folders.

settings.label: Proxy
settings.description: Leave empty to do what the computer does: when a proxy is switched on in the computer's own settings (a VPN app's "system proxy" mode does that), Telegram is reached through it, otherwise directly. Spotify and Deezer playlists are read the same way. Or name a proxy yourself: host:port, socks5://host:port (or socks5://name:password@host:port), http://host:port, or a Telegram proxy link (https://t.me/proxy?server=…&port=…&secret=…; that kind carries Telegram only, playlists are then read the computer's way). Write direct to never use a proxy. It is used from the next search, login or playlist import on. Noctis keeps this setting as plain text.
